faqs.q: My dog pulls on the lead and won't come back when called. Will the Bronze course help?
faqs.a: Those are the two things Bronze spends most of its six weeks on: heel work, which is walking on a lead without pulling, and recall, getting your dog to come back to you when called. It also covers sit and down as the two safety positions, meeting a friendly stranger while you keep your dog in control at your side, and going through doors calmly. It is basic on-lead obedience for beginners, for dogs of 12 months and upward, and Gaynor teaches you the handling as much as she teaches the dog — owners of big, strong dogs are very welcome, as she has experience of training almost all breeds.
